requirements.title: Component naming and definition
requirements.spec_says: Component MUST be named ExtentManagerV2
requirements.code_does: Component is named ExtentManager

requirements.title: FormatParams validation
requirements.spec_says: format() MUST validate all FormatParams
requirements.code_does: Validates sector_size > 0, slab_size multiple of sector_size, max_extent_size <= slab_size, region_count positive power of two, metadata device large enough

requirements.title: Superblock write at LBA 0
requirements.spec_says: format() MUST write a superblock at LBA 0 with CRC32
requirements.code_does: Superblock written at LBA 0 with CRC32 checksum over bytes 0-83

requirements.title: Initialize reads and validates superblock
requirements.spec_says: initialize() MUST read superblock, validate magic and CRC, recover from active checkpoint
requirements.code_does: Recovery reads superblock, validates magic and CRC, rebuilds from checkpoint key vectors

requirements.title: reserve_extent returns WriteHandle
requirements.spec_says: reserve_extent MUST allocate sector-aligned slot, return WriteHandle with offset, not visible until publish
requirements.code_does: Allocates sector-aligned slot via bitmap, returns WriteHandle with offset; not in get_extents until publish

requirements.title: FREE_KEY publish is silent discard
requirements.spec_says: If key equals FREE_KEY, slot MUST be freed and call returns Ok without visibility
requirements.code_does: publish_fn checks key == FREE_KEY, calls free_slot, returns Ok(Extent) but slot is freed

requirements.title: Abort/drop releases slot
requirements.spec_says: abort() or drop MUST release slot without writing key
requirements.code_does: abort_fn calls free_slot; Drop trait on WriteHandle calls abort_fn if not consumed

requirements.title: remove_extent with deferred free
requirements.spec_says: remove_extent sets key to FREE_KEY, hidden from enumeration, slot freed after checkpoint
requirements.code_does: Sets key to FREE_KEY, adds to pending_frees, freed in flush_pending_frees after checkpoint

requirements.title: Enumeration filters FREE_KEY
requirements.spec_says: get_extents returns all non-FREE_KEY; for_each_extent invokes callback for each
requirements.code_does: Both methods iterate slabs, skip FREE_KEY entries

requirements.title: Per-slab key vectors
requirements.spec_says: Each Slab MUST maintain dense Vec<u64> parallel to bitmap
requirements.code_does: Slab struct has keys: Vec<u64> initialized to FREE_KEY, parallel to bitmap

requirements.title: FREE_KEY sentinel
requirements.spec_says: FREE_KEY = u64::MAX marks unoccupied slots
requirements.code_does: pub const FREE_KEY: u64 = u64::MAX

requirements.title: BTreeMap keyed by start_offset
requirements.spec_says: Slabs MUST be in BTreeMap<u64, Slab> keyed by start_offset for O(log n) lookup
requirements.code_does: RegionState has slabs: BTreeMap<u64, Slab>; remove uses range(..=offset).next_back()

requirements.title: Checkpoint serialization with CRC32
requirements.spec_says: checkpoint MUST serialize regions with CRC32, write to inactive copy, switch active
requirements.code_does: write_checkpoint serializes all regions, computes CRC32, writes to inactive, updates superblock

requirements.title: Skip checkpoint when clean
requirements.spec_says: checkpoint MUST skip I/O if no region modified
requirements.code_does: run_checkpoint checks any_dirty flag across all regions, returns Ok(()) if all clean

requirements.title: Checkpoint coalescing
requirements.spec_says: Concurrent checkpoint calls MUST be coalesced, at most two active operations
requirements.code_does: CheckpointCoalesce struct with completed_seq/in_progress; waiters blocked on Condvar

requirements.title: Background checkpoint thread
requirements.spec_says: Background thread MUST call checkpoint at configurable interval (default 300s)
requirements.code_does: new_inner spawns thread with 300s default; uses Condvar wait_timeout

requirements.title: Dual-copy fallback recovery
requirements.spec_says: Recovery MUST try active copy first, fall back to inactive on failure
requirements.code_does: recover() tries active_offset, on error tries inactive_offset with prev_seq

requirements.title: Recovery rebuilds from key vectors
requirements.spec_says: initialize MUST restore extents by reading key vectors and marking non-FREE slots
requirements.code_does: slab_from_descriptor iterates keys, marks allocated in bitmap for non-FREE entries

requirements.title: Buddy allocator per region
requirements.spec_says: Each region MUST use buddy allocator for slab-sized chunks
requirements.code_does: BuddyAllocator struct per region with alloc/free/mark_allocated

requirements.title: Bitmap allocator with rover
requirements.spec_says: Each slab MUST use bitmap allocator with rover for even distribution
requirements.code_does: AllocationBitmap with find_free_from(rover); rover advances on each alloc

requirements.title: Size-class manager
requirements.spec_says: Size-class manager MUST index slabs by element size for O(1) lookup
requirements.code_does: SizeClassManager with HashMap<u32, Vec<u64>> for element_size -> slab offsets

requirements.title: Key sharding
requirements.spec_says: Keys sharded by key & (region_count - 1)
requirements.code_does: region_for_key uses key as usize & (regions.len() - 1)

requirements.title: Independent region locking
requirements.spec_says: Each region MUST be independently locked with parking_lot::RwLock
requirements.code_does: Vec<Arc<RwLock<RegionState>>> where RwLock is parking_lot::RwLock

requirements.title: Send + Sync
requirements.spec_says: Component MUST be Send + Sync
requirements.code_does: All fields are Arc/Mutex/RwLock wrapped; concurrent tests validate safety

requirements.title: Deferred free crash safety
requirements.spec_says: Freed slot MUST NOT be reallocated until removal persisted by checkpoint
requirements.code_does: pending_frees accumulates removals; flush_pending_frees called only after checkpoint

requirements.title: get_instance_id
requirements.spec_says: MUST provide get_instance_id() returning superblock instance_id
requirements.code_does: Implemented in IExtentManager impl, reads from shared.superblock.instance_id

requirements.title: set_checkpoint_interval
requirements.spec_says: MUST provide set_checkpoint_interval(duration)
requirements.code_does: Implemented; delegates to CheckpointTimerState, accepts Option<Duration>

requirements.title: set_metadata_ns_id
requirements.spec_says: MUST provide set_metadata_ns_id(ns_id: u32)
requirements.code_does: pub fn set_metadata_ns_id(&self, ns_id: u32) stores in Mutex<Option<u32>>

requirements.title: set_dma_alloc
requirements.spec_says: MUST provide set_dma_alloc(alloc)
requirements.code_does: pub fn set_dma_alloc(&self, alloc: DmaAllocFn) stores in Mutex

requirements.title: volatile_write_cache feature
requirements.spec_says: MAY support volatile_write_cache feature gate for flush
requirements.code_does: Feature defined in Cargo.toml; #[cfg(feature = "volatile_write_cache")] guards flush calls

requirements.title: Lifecycle operations verified by tests
requirements.spec_says: All lifecycle operations produce correct results verified by tests
requirements.code_does: tests/lifecycle.rs covers reserve, publish, enumerate, remove, abort

requirements.title: Checkpoint recovery round-trip
requirements.spec_says: Checkpoint + recovery preserves 100% of published extents
requirements.code_does: recover_checkpointed_extents test verifies 100 extents survive reboot

requirements.title: Dual-copy fallback
requirements.spec_says: Dual-copy fallback recovers from single-copy corruption
requirements.code_does: corrupt_active_falls_back_to_previous test corrupts active copy, verifies recovery

requirements.title: Concurrent correctness
requirements.spec_says: 8+ threads produce no data races, lost updates, or panics
requirements.code_does: tests/concurrent.rs uses 8 threads x 100 ops for publish, abort, and remove

requirements.title: 100M extent scale
requirements.spec_says: Component supports ~100 million extents on 10 TB data device
requirements.code_does: No test validates this scale; largest test uses 800 extents on 256 MiB

requirements.title: Checkpoint coalescing limit
requirements.spec_says: At most two active checkpoint I/O operations regardless of caller count
requirements.code_does: CheckpointCoalesce tracks in_progress and completed_seq; waiters get needed = seq+2 max

unspecified_code.description: IExtentManager interface methods reporting allocation statistics not in spec
Superblock version field is 5, spec documents version 4
MockBlockDevice supports configurable I/O fault injection for robustness testing
WriteHandle lives in interfaces::iextent_manager rather than in the component crate

Add large-scale benchmark for SC-005 validating memory and performance at 100M extent count
Update spec on-disk format section to reflect FORMAT_VERSION = 5
Add used_bytes() and capacity_bytes() to spec as monitoring/informational requirements
